name: wet_dry
label: Wet-dry cycling conditions
description: Wet and dry phase temperatures, durations and humidity of wet-dry cycling experiments.
system_prompt: Extract wet-dry cycling conditions. Report only what the paper states.
intro: This paper includes wet-dry (hydration-dehydration / evaporation) cycling experiments. For each cycling set in the structure plan below, extract the cycle conditions the paper states.

parameters.description: temperature while the sample is wet, rehydrated or held humid (e.g. "40 C and 70% RH for 20 h").
duration of the wet phase of each cycle.
relative humidity during the wet phase.
temperature while it dries / is dehydrated (e.g. "120 C for 4 h on a hot plate").
duration of the dry phase of each cycle.

rules: Which phase a single stated temperature belongs to, if the paper doesn't say, is an interpretation: `b` "assumed".
If a set's cycling scheme doesn't fit these fields (e.g. phases that change from cycle to cycle), describe it in `notes`.
